name: Top five countdown
summary: Huge #5 to #1 countdown card; each number punches in with its title, for top-list videos.

params.name: from
params.note: top N, from 5 to 10; counts down from this number to 1

params.name: items
params.note: titles separated by |, in countdown order (first is the highest number)

params.name: step
params.note: frames each number stays on screen

params.name: color
params.note: card colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
